Devnet network status

Status: development. Public devnet endpoints are available. Compare live RPC and faucet genesis before use; operator enrollment and inference readiness require separate checks. Public operator release and intake remain unverified.

A network is not ready for operator enrollment until its expected genesis, chain spec, bootnodes, public RPC/gateway, supported release, and admission authority are published and verified.
